request: El parser acepta caracteres de control ASCII sin escapar dentro de strings JSON. Corrígelo para que bytes menores que 0x20 produzcan JSMN_ERROR_INVAL, sin rechazar sus formas escapadas válidas como \n, \t o \u0001. Añade casos concisos en test/tests.c y verifica las cuatro configuraciones existentes: normal, strict, parent links y strict con parent links. No cambies la API pública ni los ejemplos.
verify_command: bash -lc "set -e; for flags in '' '-DJSMN_STRICT=1' '-DJSMN_PARENT_LINKS=1' '-DJSMN_STRICT=1 -DJSMN_PARENT_LINKS=1'; do cc $flags test/tests.c -o /tmp/jsmn-natural-eval && /tmp/jsmn-natural-eval; done"

rubric.description: Unescaped ASCII control characters are rejected while valid escaped control characters still parse in every supported compile mode.
The patch is confined to string validation and focused regression tests without API changes.
The agent validates all four compile modes without unrelated exploration or repeated equivalent runs.

request: Faça o parser de bool aceitar TRUE e FALSE sem diferenciar maiúsculas de minúsculas, inclusive formas mistas como TrUe e FaLsE. Preserve exatamente os valores já aceitos (true, false, T, F, 1 e 0) e continue rejeitando prefixos ou espaços extras. Cubra tanto a implementação com regex quanto CXXOPTS_NO_REGEX e adicione testes focados; não altere outras conversões de tipos nem a documentação.
verify_command: bash -lc "set -e; cmake -S . -B build -G Ninja -DCXXOPTS_BUILD_TESTS=ON -DCXXOPTS_BUILD_EXAMPLES=OFF -DCXXOPTS_ENABLE_INSTALL=OFF >/tmp/cxxopts-natural-configure.log; cmake --build build >/tmp/cxxopts-natural-build.log; ctest --test-dir build --output-on-failure -R '^options(_no_regex)?$'"

rubric.description: Every casing of true and false parses in regex and no-regex builds while malformed or whitespace-padded values remain invalid.
Regex and no-regex parser paths implement the same contract without broadening unrelated parsing.
The agent builds once and runs only the two relevant test targets.

request: Examine uniquement le comportement incrémental de jsmn_parse quand une chaîne JSON est tronquée ou quand le tableau de jetons est trop petit. Explique, avec des références précises au code et aux tests existants, comment JSMN_ERROR_PART et JSMN_ERROR_NOMEM préservent l'état du parser pour un nouvel appel. Signale toute limite réelle, mais ne modifie aucun fichier et ne lance pas la matrice complète de tests : il s'agit d'une revue en lecture seule.

rubric.description: The review explains both incremental error paths using precise source and existing-test evidence.
No repository file changes and no unnecessary full test matrix are produced.
rubric.evidence_source: git diff verifier and changed paths

request: Review the current boolean parsing contract in both the regex and CXXOPTS_NO_REGEX branches. Report the exact accepted spellings for true and false, show where each branch implements them, and identify whether their behavior is equivalent. Use source and existing tests as evidence. This is a read-only review: do not edit files, configure a build, or add tests.

rubric.description: The review accurately maps accepted bool spellings in both parser branches and compares them using source evidence.
No repository or generated build files are created.
rubric.evidence_source: git diff verifier and changed paths
